newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume jumps as prices continue drop.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume jumps as prices continue drop.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange further jumped to 1,639 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 1,470 and Wednesday's 552 kilos with banks continuing heavy arbitrage deals due to downward gold prices in world markets, dealers said.
Gold closed at $346.50 an ounce and 1,294,100 lira per gram, down from yesterday's $350.00 and 1,304,100 lira.
Banks usually make arbitrage deals by buying gold in dollars and selling in lira when gold prices and lira/dollar rates are suitable.
The lira firmed slightly to 115,800 against the dollar from Thursday's 115,870 close.
Dealers said free market demand which emerged due to falling prices made up a minor part of the turnover.
Bulk of the trade occurred in the morning session with 1,129 kilos, followed by 510 kilos in the afternoon, 52.4 percent of the total was traded in lira terms.
